title: Общак на кухне и теснота дома  (The Kitchen Pool and a Crowded Apartment)

segments.t: In the kitchen, Max pressures Senya into contributing his share to the hundred-thousand-ruble fund for Lyova. That evening back at the apartment, Kostya and Max discover that living with Sasha means lingerie hanging all over the bathroom and Max's entire wardrobe stuffed into a single box.
Тебе там развешивала белье в ванной?
Слушай, Саша, ты не знаешь, где мои шорты?
Представляешь, все твои вещи поместились здесь.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'Come on, guys, let us do this.' The meaning hinges on 'kids' working together with 'let's' in spoken Russian.
'Who has not chipped in yet, guys?' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'who' and 'not' in a few short words. Senya answers right away.
'We are still coming up short.' Senya anchors the line on 'somehow', while 'to gather' completes the thought.
'Who has not chipped in?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'who' before landing on 'gave up'.
'You have not chipped in.' The meaning hinges on 'you' working together with 'gave up' in spoken Russian. Senya answers right away.
'Oh, right, that is true.' The grammar packs 'and' and 'precisely' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Senka has sailed his last boat.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'Senya' and 'to sail across' in a few short words.
'Farewell, Senka.' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'farewell' and 'Senya' in a few short words. Senya answers right away.
'Kostya, those are not my panties.' The meaning hinges on 'bones' working together with 'briefs' in spoken Russian.
'Have you seen mine?' Kostya addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'my'.
Тебе там развешивала белье в ванной?
'Were you the one hanging laundry in the bathroom?' Sasha anchors the line on 'you', while 'bathtub' completes the thought. Senya answers right away.
Слушай, Саша, ты не знаешь, где мои шорты?
'Listen, Sasha, do you know where my shorts are?' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'listen' to negate the statement.
Представляешь, все твои вещи поместились здесь.
'Can you imagine, all of your things fit right in here.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'can you imagine' and 'all' in a few short words. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
